    try {
        var openedBySysId = current.opened_by.sys_id;
        if (!openedBySysId) {
            gs.info('No user found for request: ' + current.number);
            return;
        }
        
        var userGR = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (!userGR.get(openedBySysId)) {
            gs.warn('User not found: ' + requestedFor);
            return;
        }
        
        var managerSysId = userGR.manager.sys_id;
        if (!managerSysId) {
            gs.warn('No manager found for user: ' + userGR.name + ' (' + userGR.sys_id + ')');
            return;
        }

        var reqItemGR = new GlideRecord('sc_req_item');
        reqItemGR.addQuery('number', current.number); 
        reqItemGR.query();

        while (reqItemGR.next()) {
            var currentWatchList = reqItemGR.watch_list || '';
            
            if (currentWatchList.includes(managerSysId)) {
                continue; 
            }
            reqItemGR.watch_list = currentWatchList ? 
                                  currentWatchList + ',' + managerSysId : 
                                  managerSysId;
            
            reqItemGR.setWorkflow(false); 
            reqItemGR.update();
        }
        
    }
    catch (e) {
        gs.error('Business Rule Error: ' + e.message + '\nStack: ' + e.stack);
      }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-26 06:19:25</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ea50c4f293522a900dca3d6efaba1064</sys_id><sys_mod_count>24</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Add Manage to Watch List-2</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Practice3 Scripting" source="x_1734528_practi_0">935af95293b562100dca3d6efaba1031</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Practice3 Scripting">935af95293b562100dca3d6efaba1031</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_ea50c4f293522a900dca3d6efaba1064</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-26 13:10:05</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=ea50c4f293522a900dca3d6efaba1064"/></record_update>
